# Fabricator UI

> Fabricator UI is the foundation for your design system: a component registry with accessible components, extra components and its own design language. Components are copied into your project as source code with the `fabricator-ui` CLI (`npx fabricator-ui@latest add <name>`). Every component is available for Base UI, Radix UI and React Aria, in eight styles. Built with TypeScript, React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Built on shadcn/ui (MIT).

The full documentation is also available as a single file: [llms-full.txt](https://fabricator-ui.com/llms-full.txt). Every docs page is available as Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL. Component pages exist per base: `/docs/components/base/<name>` (Base UI, default), `/docs/components/radix/<name>` and `/docs/components/aria/<name>`.

## Overview

- [Introduction](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs.md): Fabricator UI is the foundation for your design system. Accessible components, three primitive bases, its own design language. Open Source. Open Code.
- [CLI](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/cli.md): Use the fabricator-ui CLI to create projects, add components and check your setup.
- [components.json](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components-json.md): Configuration for your project.
- [Theming](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/theming.md): Using CSS variables and theme tokens.
- [Package Imports](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/package-imports.md): Configure Fabricator UI with package.json imports.
- [Monorepo](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/monorepo.md): Using Fabricator UI components and the CLI in a monorepo.
- [JavaScript](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/javascript.md): How to use Fabricator UI with JavaScript
- [Changelog](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/changelog.md): Latest updates and announcements.

## Foundations

The Fabricator design language rests on these systems, shipped in the `foundations`, `fluid-hover` and `sounds` registry items.

- [Fluid Hover](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/foundations/fluid-hover.md): One highlight that glides to the item nearest the pointer, so a list never blinks between rows.
- [Motion](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/foundations/motion.md): Three spring speeds, with exits one step quicker than entrances.
- [Scrollbars](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/foundations/scrollbars.md): A thin scrollbar that stays out of the way but is there when you need it.
- [Sizes](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/foundations/sizes.md): 36px controls, 13px text, and corners that nest.
- [Sounds](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/foundations/sounds.md): Short, quiet interface sounds synthesized in the browser, off until you turn them on.
- [Surfaces](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/foundations/surfaces.md): Eight elevation levels, each with its own shadow, so layers stay distinct in light and dark mode.
- [Typography](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/foundations/typography.md): Inter at five sizes, with weights paired to optical size.

## Components

### Form & Input

- [Field](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/field.md): Combine labels, controls, and help text to compose accessible form fields and grouped inputs.
- [Button](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/button.md): Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.
- [Button Group](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/button-group.md): A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.
- [Input](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/input.md): A text input component for forms and user data entry with built-in styling and accessibility features.
- [Input Group](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/input-group.md): Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.
- [Input OTP](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/input-otp.md): Accessible one-time password component with copy-paste functionality.
- [Textarea](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/textarea.md): Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.
- [Checkbox](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/checkbox.md): A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
- [Radio Group](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/radio-group.md): A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.
- [Select](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/select.md): Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.
- [Switch](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/switch.md): A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
- [Slider](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/slider.md): An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.
- [Calendar](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/calendar.md): A calendar component that allows users to select a date or a range of dates.
- [Date Picker](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/date-picker.md): A date picker component with range and presets.
- [Combobox](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/combobox.md): Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.
- [Label](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/label.md): Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

### Layout & Navigation

- [Accordion](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/accordion.md): A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.
- [Breadcrumb](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/breadcrumb.md): Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.
- [Navigation Menu](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/navigation-menu.md): A collection of links for navigating websites.
- [Sidebar](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/sidebar.md): A composable, themeable and customizable sidebar component.
- [Tabs](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/tabs.md): A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.
- [Separator](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/separator.md): Visually or semantically separates content.
- [Scroll Area](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/scroll-area.md): Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.
- [Resizable](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/resizable.md): Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.

### Overlays & Dialogs

- [Dialog](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/dialog.md): A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.
- [Alert Dialog](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/alert-dialog.md): A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.
- [Sheet](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/sheet.md): Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.
- [Drawer](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/drawer.md): A drawer component for React.
- [Popover](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/popover.md): Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.
- [Tooltip](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/tooltip.md): A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.
- [Hover Card](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/hover-card.md): For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.
- [Context Menu](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/context-menu.md): Displays a menu of actions triggered by a right click.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/dropdown-menu.md): Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.
- [Menubar](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/menubar.md): A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.
- [Command](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/command.md): Command menu for search and quick actions.

### Feedback & Status

- [Alert](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/alert.md): Displays a callout for user attention.
- [Toast](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/toast.md): A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.
- [Progress](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/progress.md): Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.
- [Spinner](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/spinner.md): An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.
- [Skeleton](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/skeleton.md): Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.
- [Badge](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/badge.md): Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.
- [Empty](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/empty.md): Use the Empty component to display an empty state.

### Display & Media

- [Avatar](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/avatar.md): An image element with a fallback for representing the user.
- [Card](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/card.md): Displays a card with header, content, and footer.
- [Table](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/table.md): A responsive table component.
- [Data Table](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/data-table.md): Powerful table and datagrids built using TanStack Table.
- [Chart](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/chart.md): Beautiful charts. Built using Recharts. Copy and paste into your apps.
- [Carousel](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/carousel.md): A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.
- [Aspect Ratio](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/aspect-ratio.md): Displays content within a desired ratio.
- [Typography](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/typography.md): Styles for headings, paragraphs, lists, etc.
- [Item](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/item.md): A versatile component for displaying content with media, title, description, and actions.
- [Kbd](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/kbd.md): Used to display textual user input from keyboard.

### Misc

- [Collapsible](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/collapsible.md): An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.
- [Toggle](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/toggle.md): A two-state button that can be either on or off.
- [Toggle Group](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/toggle-group.md): A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.
- [Pagination](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/pagination.md): Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.
- [Direction](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/direction.md): A provider component that sets the text direction for your application.

### Chat & AI

- [Attachment](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/attachment.md): Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload state, and actions.
- [Bubble](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/bubble.md): Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.
- [Marker](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/marker.md): Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation.
- [Message](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/message.md): Displays a message in a conversation, with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment.
- [Message Scroller](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/message-scroller.md): A chat scroll container that anchors turns, opens saved transcripts, follows streamed responses, loads history without jumping, and jumps to any message.
- [Questionnaire](https://fabricator-ui.com/docs/components/base/questionnaire.md): A multi-step questionnaire with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform, and skippable questions.
